progression.narrative: The performance opens on Fk4 and dwells most on D in Reng-e Farah. The line peaks at G4 (380.5 Hz) at 2:02.3. It closes on the tonic (Fk4 → G3 → Ak3 → Fk4 → G3 → G3).
